# json-ld

Install: `composer require rasuvaeff/json-ld`

Runtime deps: `ext-json`, `ext-mbstring`, `ext-dom`, `psr/http-client ^1.0`,
`psr/http-factory ^1.0`, `psr/http-message (^1.0 || ^2.0)`.

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`
- Immutable by default (`final readonly class`)
- No implicit I/O: remote context loading happens only through an explicitly
  injected `ContextLoaderInterface` implementation; the default loader never
  touches network or filesystem beyond parsing in-memory data
- <!-- Add package-specific rules here -->
